annotations.title: Look up one verified track record

description: Look up one verified track record by Hyperliquid vault address, vault URL or name, Lighter public pool index or URL, dHEDGE vault address, or the address of an AI agent whose operator published its Hyperliquid or Polymarket account: return, BTC over the same dates, max drawdown, Sortino, 30-day return and TVL (for Polymarket agents: ROI on money put in, PnL and win rate), computed by TradingAgentStack from Hyperliquid's public API (not self-reported), with the window, the data date, whether it passes the 30% drawdown gate and until when it is fresh, and a SHA-256 of the record so an agent can cite exactly what it read. On the hosted endpoint the hash also comes signed (an ES256 JWT whose public keys are published), so anyone can check later that TradingAgentStack issued that exact record. Unknown addresses come back as not_tracked with how to get verified. Not investment advice.

query.description: Vault or agent account address (0x...), app.hyperliquid.xyz/vaults/ URL, or vault or agent name
